title: Infographic: CNC Machining Order Process
summary: From order placed to parts delivered, learn about the steps involved in manufacturing a CNC-machined part.
body_markdown:
Xometry is your one-stop shop for custom CNC-machined parts. The Xometry Instant Quoting Engine® and our worldwide manufacturing network enable us to match your designs with experienced shops for the best pricing and lead times on your parts.


But what's involved in producing custom-machined components? What steps take place between placing an order and receiving your parts? Our infographic aims to answer those questions, covering everything from quoting and ordering to DFM review and sourcing, pre-production steps, and more. Learn more about our machining capabilities by visiting our[CNC services page](https://www.xometry.com/capabilities/cnc-machining-service/) .
